plan.failureSummary: The Briefcase chatbot API endpoint (https://briefcase.chat/api/chat) failed with HTTP 500 Internal Server Errors when processing chat inputs. As a result, no responses were rendered in the UI, causing the page.ai evaluation to report status 'FAIL'.
observedIndicators: Browser logs show repeated HTTP 500 responses from 'https://briefcase.chat/api/chat (x4)'.

The page.ai evaluation returned status 'FAIL' with the issue: 'The chatbot fails to render or generate responses to submitted user questions; after entering both legal and off-topic questions, no response is generated or displayed in the chat interface.'
The UI screenshot and page text analysis confirm that no assistant response messages appear in the main chat view after questions are submitted.

remediationSteps.summary: Fix HTTP 500 errors in backend API endpoint /api/chat
remediationSteps.details: Investigate the server-side logs for the Briefcase chatbot endpoint (/api/chat) to fix the HTTP 500 internal server error occurring during message handling.

plan.notes: The failure is caused by an application backend defect where /api/chat responds with HTTP 500. The test code correctly expects the chatbot to pass topic compliance evaluation when operational.
